system.description:
You shape water according to your will.

Choose a space of water or ice within 10 spaces.

You can move that water or ice to an adjacent space or lift it up to 1 space above the ground.

Alternatively, you can carefully shape water and ice while the spell is active, such as creating an ice sculpture, or clearing water from a path.

Additionally, you can freeze or unfreeze water instead of moving it.

Your control over the water lasts until the start of your next turn, after which it returns to normal.

While this spell is active, you can use an Action to manipulate water again, selecting the same target or a new target as you wish. If you select a new target, you relinquish control over the previous target.

Each extra success extends the duration of your control by +1 rounds.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.yVI8Op6nz2bS1sQo]{Shape Water}
